racials.name: Walk on Air
racials.description: Instant, 1.5 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

racials.name: Read Leyline
racials.description: 2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby leyline, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 30 sec if no leyline is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

racials.name: Wind Blessed
racials.description: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 3%.

racials.description: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
